Malaysia Closes Balaji Srinivasan's Network School

Malaysia has closed the Balaji Srinivasan Network School, an institution associated with Balaji Srinivasan. The closure occurred after the school had been operational for two years. Reports indicate that licensing issues were the reason for the shutdown.
